title: What players fit to the {tank}
what-they-fit: The setups players run on the {tank} in {mode}

col.player-winrate-tip: The same players’ overall win rate, across their whole account, weighted by their battles with this setup.
col.delta-tip: This setup’s figure minus the same players’ overall one, across their whole account.
col.usage-tip: Players who ran it in at least one counted battle, over the players counted.
col.player-rating-tip: The same players’ overall rating, across their whole account, weighted by their battles with this setup.

crew-skills: The crew skills trained on the {tank} in {mode}
crew-skills-hint: Each skill the {role} had trained, counted in players whose crew has that seat, beside how the battles fought with it went.

counted.equipment: Counted as whole sets of three devices, the way players fit them, in players who ran each set.
counted.consumables: Counted as whole sets of three consumables, in players who ran each set.
counted.directives: Counted one directive at a time, in players who ran it.
counted.field-mods: Counted as whole field modification trees, every pair as the player took it, in players who ran each tree.

top-battles: The best battles fought in the {tank} in {mode}
top-battles-hint: Each player’s best battle in this tank by damage dealt, and exactly what they fitted for it. Open a battle for its full report.
thin-row: Fewer than {count} players ran this, so these figures say more about them than about the setup.
top-players-hint: The best players in this tank among those whose battles are recorded, ranked on their whole record in it, with what they fitted in their latest recorded battle. Open a row for their crew.
